tables.license: MIT AND CC-BY-4.0; ReactZyme dataset MIT with UniProt/Rhea attribution retained
tables.qualification: Native positive pairs only; no manufactured negatives. Native reaction input concatenates substrate/product molecule SMILES without a reaction arrow; preserve this upstream representation. Original train+validation pool is not silently relabeled as training. No new homology audit or model evaluation claimed.
tables.reference_evidence: Curated UniProt/Rhea positive enzyme-reaction associations; native sequence-smi split from ReactZyme release.

tables.license: CC-BY-4.0; native M-CSA annotations and UniProt sequences
tables.qualification: Native M-CSA reaction-associated reference catalytic residues, joined to frozen UniProt FASTA and checked for exact amino-acid identity at every labeled position. Reaction representation retains ChEBI/name/stoichiometry participants, not invented SMILES. Binary zeros are unannotated residues, not experimentally proven nonfunctional sites. Only reference annotations retained; homology-transferred labels excluded. Derived partitions close native-entry and exact-sequence connected components; they remain development-exposed, not a new independent homology holdout. Previously inspected M-CSA data overlap the existing mechanism companion.
tables.reference_evidence: Direct M-CSA reference catalytic-residue annotations and separately licensed UniProt sequence; no EasIFA annotations or code required.

tables.license: MIT AND CC-BY-4.0; CatPred contribution MIT; underlying BRENDA/UniProt data CC-BY-4.0
tables.qualification: Release subset contains only native rows explicitly labeled brenda, using each retained row's value/log10_value. All pooled max/mean target columns, sabio rows and ambiguous uniprot_search origins are excluded. This changes the prediction target from CatPred's aggregate benchmark to a retained BRENDA-record response. Source preprocessing capped extreme values; no claim of uncensored raw laboratory measurements. Intended source units retained, no independent experimental unit audit. Derived 40%-cluster split is not the original random split. Native combined source assets must not be redistributed as part of this cleared subset.
tables.reference_evidence: Identifiable BRENDA retained record, established by pinned source-specific processors and merge.py; mathematical log10/value consistency checked.

tables.license: CC-BY-4.0 on Zenodo17310823 Data.zip; preserve per-paper provenance and attribution
tables.qualification: Only explicit native parent rows (#PARENT#), identical recorded assay context, nonidentical valid parent/variant sequences, finite native fitness and resolved campaign reference/assay metadata. Parent replicates aggregate by median with every reference ID retained. Native fitness and derived change are assay-specific, not universal kcat/yield. Source collection/evidence separates LLM-extracted literature from the other experimental collections. DOI fields can reference a compiled data deposit, not an individual primary paper. Mutation strings preserved without claiming independently validated residue numbering. Derived partitions close reference-DOI and exact-parent-sequence components; this is not an independent homology holdout. Missing assay conditions remain unknown; within-source comparisons require audit before a frozen benchmark.
tables.reference_evidence: Source EnzEngDB release experiments and metadata; no fabricated fitness labels. Delta is explicitly derived from native variant measurement and compatible parent reference(s).

tables.license: CC-BY-4.0; EnzEngDB data release with explicit record/paper attribution

metrics: native measured-oracle goal attainment for exact observed sequences only

tables.qualification: Inverse biocatalyst-sequence design subtype, not general small-molecule catalyst generation. Only ARNLD curated campaigns with explicit finite nonnegative TTN/reaction-activity-percent labels and qualified parent/variant sequence context. All DMSDB and LLMDB rows excluded. Desired response is an explicit design goal, not an outcome-prediction input. Each native variant is a demonstrated solution rather than the only correct output. Oracle values exist only for exact observed variant/context/endpoint tuples; unseen generated sequences require experiments and receive no fabricated response. Activity-percent is retained as reported, not automatically equated with isolated yield. Views overlap the mutation-effect source rows.
tables.reference_evidence: Native explicit catalytic endpoint from the CC-BY-4.0 EnzEngDB experiment member, with source row ID and parent reference inherited from qualified mutation view.

quarantined_tables.license: EasIFA code MIT; source-data redistribution grant unresolved. UniProt/Rhea attribution retained. Local analysis only until data terms are cleared.
quarantined_tables.qualification: Qualified exact-ID/exact-sequence join. Only native EasIFA test proteins available here; training and structure coordinates not acquired. Repeated reactions share the same protein-level site reference and must remain grouped. Reference zeros mean unannotated, not verified nonfunctional residues. Binding/catalytic/other site types stay distinct; this is reference recovery, not newly measured reaction-specific sites.
quarantined_tables.reference_evidence: Native EasIFA UniProt site labels plus separate curated UniProt-Rhea positive association; 1-based inclusive intervals converted using the pinned upstream dataloader.

quarantined_tables.license: Zenodo14775076 dataset MIT; pinned repository code MIT. BRENDA/SABIO-RK upstream rights require separate redistribution review; local analysis retained.
quarantined_tables.qualification: kcat, Km and Ki are separate endpoint tables. Native max/mean aggregate target retained alongside the nonaggregated row value. pH/temperature describe individual source measurements and are metadata, not inputs to a pooled target. Native combined pool has a deterministic derived 40%-cluster split, not a reproduction of original random split. Homology clusters are native annotations and have not been independently rerun. Intended source units are kcat s^-1 and Km/Ki mM; pinned SABIO processing code multiplies minute^-1/hour^-1 values by60/3600, raising an upstream normalization concern. Per-measurement unit lineage is absent from released tables, so no correction or physical-unit accuracy claim is made here.
quarantined_tables.reference_evidence: Published CatPred-DB aggregate kinetic targets compiled from BRENDA/SABIO-RK; sequence-source annotations, native row IDs and homology clusters retained.
